desc: SD card is PHYSICALLY PRESENT as of 2026-08-02 (CJ). sdhci-pci binds mmc0 (ADMA 64-bit) but has never seen media. Test end to end: card detect, /proc/partitions shows mmcblk0[p1], mount, read, WRITE + fsync, reboot, re-verify persistence. Then wire into t6040-data-mount as a persistent /data target alongside NVMe (script already polls /dev/mmcblk0p1 -> /mnt/sd; t6040-data-sync already prefers /mnt/nvme then /mnt/sd). Fastest available path to the storage milestone since NVMe is blocked on the CQ wrap assert. Rig: claude. RESULT 2026-08-02: PASS. 58.2 GiB SDXC at UHS-I SDR104, mmcblk0p1 mounts, write + 8MB dd verified, and BOTH survived a full reboot with identical md5 83cc39a95ac8b2d0e95b67f7eb8a6960. First persistent storage on the M4 under Linux, independent of USB and NVMe. Doc: evidence/2026-08-02-t6040-SD-CARD-WORKS-persistent-storage.md
